The '''F-T2 Quell''' was a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] in the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] which performed strikefighter roles. Created in the shipyards of [[Dromund Kalakar]], the Quell was designed in accordance to tradition of balance between offense, defense and speed. Carrying two twin laser cannons freed up systems for both a fast engine and the ability to equip [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedoes]] or a range of different missiles.
